notes: Prerelease 3.0.0-beta.7 is a test version of Printer Bot 3.0 and it can have mistakes. It needs no new import. Every printer with a print queue has a button, Clear print queue. Check this printer ends its test line with a cut, Check again works at once after you answer, and answering No offers the Windows printer driver on Letter paper. A printer on thermal output has a box, Do not cut Hype Trains, which prints a Hype Train on it as one strip of paper. Reload the dock after the update.
